pages.summary: Corrected bridges to extension-trait methods and narrowed the associated-item restriction to unresolved Self paths. Removed CI fixture commentary and tightened build-specific guidance.
Explained that support modules compile in the function-replacement mirror rather than modifying original game source. Removed CI framing and clarified destination fields.
Presented native state as a build-time refusal with the implemented error and attachment alternative, without describing a hypothetical facility.
Clarified that API points on Game methods supply the side's Host, while retaining catalog version and subscription guidance.

Restricted replacement-cell coverage to eligible functions and listed representative exclusions. Removed status wording, an unsupported performance assertion, and the pinned source hash from the external documentation link.
